t: You're at Hampstead tube station, on the Edgware branch of the Northern line, between Golders Green and Belsize Park. It's the northernmost underground station on that branch, on the boundary of fare zones 2 and 3. The architect Leslie Green designed it. He is best known for his stations on the Underground in the early twentieth century, with oxblood red glazed faïence blocks, pillars, semi-circular windows on the first floor, and patterned tiled interiors in the Modern Style.
